impact: A clean beat and raise eases fears that AI demand is cracking, which supports the memory names (MU, DRAM, SNXX) and AI infrastructure (NBIS) after a heavy November selloff, and backs the capex story for MSFT and GOOGL. The lower margin guide and the extra week in Q4 temper it, so watch whether the after-hours gain holds at Wednesday's open.
source: Nvidia release via StockTitan / Investing.com / FXStreet / Motley Fool
summary: Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8B, up 103% y/y, vs about $108.9B expected, and adjusted EPS of $2.68 vs $2.47. It guided Q4 revenue to $130B plus or minus 3% vs about $125B consensus, assuming no China data center compute revenue, with gross margin guided down to 71% to 72% from about 74.8%. On the call, interim CEO Colette Kress said Vera Rubin generated nearly $20B in its first quarter of shipments and lifted the fiscal 2028 revenue growth outlook to about 75% from 70%, with demand far exceeding supply; China sales of approved products were about $2.4B. Shares rose about 2% to 5% after hours.
title: Nvidia beats, guides Q4 to $130B and lifts FY28 growth view to ~75%
